description: FILED s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 10:1x) as the umbrella for s514a member 2 (production review item 5; `use Storable` fails today: XS, no PCL build; Test-Simple's Test2::IPC::Driver::Files and two Test2::API files use it).  DESIGN RULING (Fable): PERL'S FORMAT, not a PCL-private one -- files and frozen strings must interchange with real perl (caches, IPC, fixtures), so the WRITER is held to byte-identity with perl's freeze/nfreeze on canonical structures and the READER to thawing perl-written bytes; the format is read from the Storable dist's Storable.xs FORMAT comment and verified against hexdumps of perl's output.  Native header: byteorder string 12345678 + ivsize/longsize/ptrsize/nvsize 8; files carry the pst0 magic; nstore/nfreeze = network header + SX_NETINT.  In scope: undef, integers (SX_BYTE / SX_INTEGER / SX_NETINT), doubles, byte and utf8 strings, arrays, hashes (+SX_FLAG_HASH), refs with SX_OBJECT back-references (sharing + cycles preserved -- mandatory probe), blessed (SX_BLESS / SX_IX_BLESS), SV_YES/NO, overload, weakrefs read as refs, hooks if budget.  Out: CODE / GLOB / tied / REGEXP (die with perl's texts), Deparse/Eval; a newer stream version dies as perl does.   and  honoured.  BAR: guard Pl/t/storable-shim-01.t (~35 rows incl. nfreeze bytes == perl's computed at run time, store under perl / retrieve under PCL and the reverse, sharing identity after thaw), a ~40-row probe matrix, the CPAN board 0 NEW / 0 LOST.
